edits.new: | Integration dependencies | INT-34 (ACE common module e-signature path; stubbed per section 12.8 until the integration inventory carries it) |

disposition.target: Integration and test environment plan for wave 2 (EasyApp test tenant, harness pack, seeding, evidence format)
disposition.change: Agree the EasyApp test tenant and route via INT-34, the signed-PDF fixture, SIT harness hosts, seeding, evidence format and pass/fail gate with QA and the ACE team.
disposition.note: Test tenant, route, fixture, harness and evidence values are not in any source; the story cannot take them without the owners.

disposition.target: Integration inventory (TSD P6 v2 T5.1) and ACE common module interface specification
disposition.change: Add INT-34 with request and result shape, endpoint and certificate issuer; carry endpoint and certificate as secret references (NFR-052).
disposition.note: Header integration dependency now names INT-34 and the stub of section 12.8 stands in until the owner publishes the shape.

disposition.target: API specification for /api/recovery/comms/v1 and Architecture v5 connection matrix (P3 row)
disposition.change: Add a cancel operation for P3 on /api/recovery/comms/v1 or an event from P3 that P6 consumes, and name it in P3's expiry story.
disposition.note: No cancel operation or P6 event exists for offer expiry; AC6 stays as written until the contract is published.

disposition.target: FSD P5 Document hub v3 (A1.1 and A2 feature set)
disposition.change: Add the signature requirement text as OQ-P5-13 and record the signature request as a document event and metadata row.
disposition.note: P5 owns the signature table with no FSD requirement behind it; the PRD must carry the missing text.

disposition.target: Architecture v5 and Ownership Map (signature_request owner)
disposition.change: Confirm with P5 the read path for request status before wave 2; this service creates the request through P5's contract and calls the treatment service.
disposition.note: Signature ownership is split between P6 and P5 with no stated read path for the case screen.

disposition.target: TSD P5 Document hub v2 Appendix T-A.1 and API Specification
disposition.change: Add the five signature-request operations with API IDs, paths and query names, settled with rwb-comms in the same review.
disposition.note: No P5 source holds signature endpoints or API IDs; the five operations need to be added to the API specification.

disposition.target: TSD P6 Communications v2 T3.1, TSD P5 Document hub v2 T3.1 and Physical Schema rwb_document.sql
disposition.change: Keep signature_request in rwb_document, remove it from the rwb-comms model, and add its columns, constraints and indexes to TSD P5 T3.1 and rwb_document.sql.
disposition.note: Ownership ruling places the table in P5, but P5 has no data model for it; the data steward must add it.

disposition.target: TSD S2 Treatment v2 (T3.1, T-A.1) and FSD S2 A2.7 to A2.9
disposition.change: Add five nullable signature columns with two indexes on the service's Flyway sequence, add the record to the update operation, name the two events, and let the offer-validity timer close the window.
disposition.note: Treatment-side signature fields, operation, events and lists are missing from the S2 sources.

disposition.target: Architecture v5 slide 13 connection matrix and TSD S2 Treatment API specification
disposition.change: Publish the signature record on the update operation of /api/recovery/treatment/v1 with a fake, and record the later move to a Temporal activity.
disposition.note: The seam has two transports and directions across sources; the S2 operation must be published to unblock the build.

disposition.target: Architecture v5 and the PRD for rwb-treatment, rwb-document and rwb-comms
disposition.change: Give rwb-treatment the signature record and window closure, rwb-document the request and signed version, rwb-comms the basis and circuit, reconciled on the published operation and events.
disposition.note: Three owners replace one legacy transaction; no source states how they stay consistent, so the reconciliation must be agreed.
